<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/get_node_schema"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns segment/field structural metadata parsed from every grammar
JSON file (e.g. demo.json) found alongside main.lua in the node's
directory. This powers schema-aware autocomplete for parsed message nodes
and is pure structural metadata — it does not execute the script or read
any sample values. Raises 404 if the node directory or its
node_config.json cannot be found.
